title: Illustration for “Don’t Worry, These Gangly-armed Cartoons…” (Katharina Brenner)
lede: The hero image of AIGA Eye on Design’s 2019 article on the style: three flat figures with blue, violet, and orange skin reaching toward a browser window with a thumbs-down.
summary: Three gangly, flat figures with non-natural skin on mint green, around a thumbs-down browser window. Editorial illustration, 2019.

creator.name: Katharina Brenner, with figures by Pablo Stanley (Humaaans)

evidence.note: Inspected the 1200 × 750 original (`Alegria_Hero-1.jpg`) from the AIGA article and stored it. The same image is on [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Corporate_Memphis_(2019).png), where the Wikipedia article uses it.

styles.note: Clear fit: long bendy limbs, small blank heads, violet, blue, and orange skin, flat fills with no outline, and a pale background. It is also the image that Wikipedia uses for the style.

context: The AIGA caption reads: “Image by Katharina Brenner. Illustrations are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license. Illustrations by Pablo Stanley, via humaaans design library. All illustrations have been edited.” [AIGA Eye on Design](https://eyeondesign.aiga.org/dont-worry-these-gangley-armed-cartoons-are-here-to-protect-you-from-big-tech/).
The image is built from [Humaaans](ref:humaaans-illustration-library-2018) figures; the article itself is about Facebook’s [Alegria](ref:facebook-alegria-illustration-system-2017) and its imitators.
observed: The background is a flat mint green. A white browser window with a grey frame and three dots stands in the centre and shows a large navy thumbs-down.
A figure with violet skin walks in from the left in a yellow sweater and pale teal trousers, with long arms that end in small pointed hands.
A figure with orange skin in a blue top lunges toward the window with both arms raised; a single white tear marks the face.
A figure with pale blue skin and a long navy ponytail stands on the right in an orange jacket and pink trousers, one arm stretched out.
All shapes are flat fills without outlines; each garment has one darker tone for the far side.
interpretation: The image uses the style to comment on it: the cheerful figures react to a thumbs-down, the reverse of Alegria’s thumbs-up.
borrow: Put one interface object, such as a browser window, in the centre and let the figures react to it from both sides.
Use a single pale background color instead of white to hold several bright skin and clothing colors together.

images.alt: Flat illustration on mint green: three long-limbed figures with violet, orange, and pale blue skin walk and reach toward a white browser window that shows a large navy thumbs-down.
images.caption: Illustration by Katharina Brenner with Humaaans figures by Pablo Stanley, for [AIGA Eye on Design](https://eyeondesign.aiga.org/dont-worry-these-gangley-armed-cartoons-are-here-to-protect-you-from-big-tech/), 2019. CC BY 4.0.

rights.statement: The AIGA caption states a CC BY 4.0 license for the illustrations; the Commons copy carries the same license. Credit: Katharina Brenner; figures by Pablo Stanley (Humaaans).
